verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents Grafana's MCP server for connecting AI agents and general API/CLI access, but nothing describes scoped or least-privilege API credential issuance (e.g., service accounts with restricted roles/permissions) for agent use. Missing for 10: documentation of service-account or API-key scoping/role restriction, any mention of least-privilege credential provisioning specifically for AI agents, and confirmation that MCP server auth supports scoped tokens.
